mapper.select: SELECT code, label, display_order, is_custom AS custom FROM training_goal_category ORDER BY display_order, code

SELECT goal.id, goal.standard_number, goal.category_code, category.label AS category_label, goal.goal_text, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM student_training_goal assigned WHERE assigned.student_id = #{studentId} AND assigned.goal_id = goal.id ) AS assigned FROM training_goal goal JOIN training_goal_category category ON category.code = goal.category_code WHERE goal.goal_type = 'STANDARD'
AND goal.goal_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND goal.category_code = #{categoryCode}
ORDER BY category.display_order, goal.standard_number, goal.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_goal (category_code, goal_text, goal_type, owner_student_id) VALUES (#{categoryCode}, #{goalText}, #{goalType}, #{ownerStudentId})
INSERT INTO student_training_goal (student_id, goal_id, initial_level, current_level, phase, status) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{goalId}, #{initialLevel}, #{currentLevel}, #{phase}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT item.id, item.student_id, item.goal_id, goal.standard_number, goal.goal_type, goal.category_code, category.label AS category_label, goal.goal_text, item.initial_level, item.current_level, item.phase, item.status FROM student_training_goal item JOIN training_goal goal ON goal.id = item.goal_id JOIN training_goal_category category ON category.code = goal.category_code WHERE item.id = #{id} AND item.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM student_training_goal WHERE id = #{id} AND student_id = #{studentId}
DELETE FROM training_goal WHERE id = #{goalId} AND goal_type = 'CUSTOM' AND owner_student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT goal.id AS goal_id, goal.standard_number, goal.goal_type, goal.goal_text, COALESCE(MIN(module.code), category.code) AS module_code, COALESCE(MIN(module.label), category.label) AS module_label, COALESCE(MIN(module.display_order), category.display_order) AS module_order, activity.record_date AS date, COALESCE(SUM(activity.total_count), 0) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(activity.incomplete_count), 0) AS incomplete_count, COALESCE(SUM(activity.assisted_count), 0) AS assisted_count, COALESCE(SUM(activity.independent_count), 0) AS independent_count, COALESCE(SUM(activity.unclassified_count), 0) AS unclassified_count FROM student_training_goal assigned JOIN training_goal goal ON goal.id = assigned.goal_id JOIN training_goal_category category ON category.code = goal.category_code LEFT JOIN behavior_training_goal relation ON relation.standard_number = goal.standard_number LEFT JOIN behavior_catalog_metadata metadata ON metadata.behavior_code = relation.behavior_code LEFT JOIN behavior_module module ON module.code = metadata.module_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT behavior.behavior_code, class_row.record_date, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(behavior.status_code = 'INCOMPLETE') AS incomplete_count, SUM(behavior.status_code = 'ASSISTED') AS assisted_count, SUM(behavior.status_code = 'INDEPENDENT') AS independent_count, SUM(behavior.status_code IS NULL) AS unclassified_count FROM behavior_record behavior JOIN class_record class_row ON class_row.id = behavior.class_record_id WHERE class_row.student_id = #{studentId} AND class_row.record_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY behavior.behavior_code, class_row.record_date ) activity ON activity.behavior_code = relation.behavior_code WHERE assigned.student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY goal.id, goal.standard_number, goal.goal_type, goal.goal_text, category.code, category.label, category.display_order, activity.record_date ORDER BY module_order, goal.standard_number, goal.id, activity.record_date
SELECT id, standard_number, category_code, goal_text, goal_type, owner_student_id FROM training_goal WHERE standard_number = #{standardNumber} AND goal_type = 'STANDARD'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM behavior_record behavior JOIN class_record class_row ON class_row.id = behavior.class_record_id WHERE class_row.student_id = #{studentId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM behavior_training_goal relation WHERE relation.standard_number = #{standardNumber} AND relation.behavior_code = behavior.behavior_code AND (relation.sub_behavior_code = behavior.sub_behavior_code OR (relation.sub_behavior_code IS NULL AND behavior.sub_behavior_code IS NULL) OR (relation.sub_behavior_code IS NOT NULL AND behavior.sub_behavior_code IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM behavior_catalog_option opt WHERE opt.code = relation.sub_behavior_code AND opt.label = behavior.sub_behavior_code))) )

SELECT behavior.id, class_row.record_date, behavior.occurred_at, course.code AS course_code, course.label AS course_label, environment.code AS environment_code, environment.label AS environment_label, behavior_type.code AS behavior_code, behavior_type.label AS behavior_label, behavior.status_code, status_type.label AS status_label FROM behavior_record behavior JOIN class_record class_row ON class_row.id = behavior.class_record_id JOIN course_type course ON course.code = class_row.course_code JOIN environment_type environment ON environment.code = class_row.environment_code JOIN behavior_type behavior_type ON behavior_type.code = behavior.behavior_code LEFT JOIN behavior_status_type status_type ON status_type.code = behavior.status_code WHERE class_row.student_id = #{studentId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM behavior_training_goal relation WHERE relation.standard_number = #{standardNumber} AND relation.behavior_code = behavior.behavior_code AND (relation.sub_behavior_code = behavior.sub_behavior_code OR (relation.sub_behavior_code IS NULL AND behavior.sub_behavior_code IS NULL) OR (relation.sub_behavior_code IS NOT NULL AND behavior.sub_behavior_code IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM behavior_catalog_option opt WHERE opt.code = relation.sub_behavior_code AND opt.label = behavior.sub_behavior_code))) ) ORDER BY behavior.occurred_at DESC, behavior.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT goal_text FROM training_goal WHERE standard_number = #{standardNumber} LIMIT 1

SELECT br.id, cr.record_date AS recordDate, DATE_FORMAT(br.occurred_at, '%H:%i') AS occurredTime, ct.label AS courseLabel, et.label AS environmentLabel, bt.label AS behaviorLabel, (SELECT bco.label FROM behavior_catalog_option bco WHERE bco.code = br.sub_behavior_code AND bco.option_type = 'SUB_BEHAVIOR' LIMIT 1) AS subBehaviorLabel, br.status_code AS statusCode, CASE br.status_code WHEN 'independent' THEN '独立完成' WHEN 'assisted' THEN '辅助完成' ELSE '未完成' END AS statusLabel, COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(brcs.custom_text, bco.label) SEPARATOR '，') FROM behavior_record_catalog_selection brcs JOIN behavior_catalog_option bco ON bco.code = brcs.option_code WHERE brcs.behavior_record_id = br.id AND bco.option_type = 'PERFORMANCE'), '未填写' ) AS performanceText FROM behavior_training_goal btg JOIN behavior_record br ON br.behavior_code = btg.behavior_code JOIN class_record cr ON cr.id = br.class_record_id JOIN behavior_type bt ON bt.code = br.behavior_code JOIN course_type ct ON ct.code = cr.course_code JOIN environment_type et ON et.code = cr.environment_code WHERE btg.standard_number = #{standardNumber} ORDER BY br.occurred_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM behavior_training_goal btg JOIN behavior_record br ON br.behavior_code = btg.behavior_code WHERE btg.standard_number = #{standardNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_goal_change_log (student_goal_id, standard_number, goal_text, changed_by, changed_at, field_name, old_value, new_value) VALUES (#{studentGoalId}, #{standardNumber}, #{goalText}, #{changedBy}, #{changedAt}, #{fieldName}, #{oldValue}, #{newValue})
